thread:
Avery (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: we asked for patterns on why we're winning or losing deals and the top asks we should feed into roadmap. I'll summarize a few themes then open the floor.

Maya (Sales): Field notes: wins when we demo low-latency and clear cost math. Losses when prospects worry about SSO, key management, or vendor lock-in. Several enterprise teams asked about dedicated capacity SLAs and a clear pricing model for steady-state high-throughput.

Priya (CS): Add retention angle: customers who adopt our Optimize recommendations and onboarding checklist stick. When we lose later, it's usually due to unclear handoff docs and missing runbooks for their SREs.

Sam (Product): From product side: top asks to prioritize are BYOK/KMS, enterprise audit logs, better onboarding flows, and a SOC2 artifact pack for sales. We'll draft a roadmap note after this thread.

Leo (SE): Technical ask: customers want model pinning + deterministic evals and small config examples for rollouts. Tiny SE snippets reduce friction. Example we include in POC:
```yaml
model: redwood-4x
pin: v2.1
rollout: 10% canary
```

Jon (Eng): Engineering note: the main stability losses tie to long-tail latency spikes under bursty batching. We're adding KV-cache miss metrics and per-request tracing to help correlate.

Maya (Sales): Follow-up: BYOK ETAs? A handful of active deals are paused pending KMS/legal details.

Avery (CEO): BYOK + KMS is prioritized for Dedicated/Private. Tentative Q3 beta. Meanwhile, @Sam please own a one-pager for sales with security bullets, suggested contract language, and a short how-it-works section.

Sam (Product): On it. I'll post a draft in #product-resources by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (CS): Request: can we add a "sample ops checklist" to docs? On-call teams prefer checklists and it shortens time-to-value.

Leo (SE): I'll add a step-by-step POC guide and attach runnable snippets to the SE kit.

Jon (Eng): For oncall: we're rolling out `request.trace_id` in logs. If you see a spike, paste the trace id in #eng-oncall and we'll pull traces.

Avery (CEO): Two asks for leadership: 1) approve a small docs/SE collateral sprint next month, 2) push to publish SOC2 artifacts + a public FAQ for sales. I'll raise with finance.

All-Hands Bot: Follow-up notes + action items posted -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1773456789

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This will help shorten sales cycles.

Priya (CS): Can someone pull a list of lost deals by reason for the quarter? That helped us triage last year.

Sam (Product): I'll pull the Q1 loss reasons with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks everyone. If you have call clips or customer quotes, drop them on the Notion page. Closing thread.
